_about: WS-17 EM-T14b-1, email_app_master_plan.md 13.9.2 item 3. Synthetic mails for the Insights finance job. Each mail looks real, and each one is invented: every name and address is made up, and every address ends in .example. 'screen' is the expected answer of the screen (EM-T14b-0) for each domain. 'expected' lists the facts that the fin-1 rules must store, with the source ('body' or a file name). An amount is a string, and null means no amount under fin-1. 'pad_chars' makes the loader add filler text, so a body passes the cut of 8,000 characters.
